parent_evidence.result: Both Order-5 hits succeeded and replayed 3/3 at 3 seconds and 3/3 at 5 seconds; all originals and alpha/dual variants were officially Lean-accepted.

target: Determine whether the unchanged compact-superposition capability transfers beyond the released Order-5 residual family and whether 5 seconds adds reliable reach over the production-equivalent 3 seconds.

frozen_inputs.construction: Canonical-hash selection after excluding every prior experiment ID and reconstructible equation-pair hash; up to 20 TRUE and 20 FALSE rows per family, with labels written separately.

sealed_labels.rule: The search runner receives no label path. Hash the raw result before a separate evaluator loads labels.

live_rivals.H_transfer: The existing compact route proves unseen TRUE rows in at least one non-Order-5 family with no FALSE candidate.
live_rivals.H_order5_specific: The verified residual hits do not transfer to any prior-contact-excluded Normal/Hard row.
live_rivals.H_budget_margin: Five seconds produces valid TRUE hits not reached at three seconds.
live_rivals.H_no_budget_effect: The 3- and 5-second hit sets are identical.
live_rivals.H_soundness_or_measurement: A candidate appears on a sealed FALSE row, replay fails, Lean rejects, or result/input boundaries differ.

intervention.verifier: target-root equality, replay_dag, certificate <=100000 bytes, then official Lean 4.32.2 judge for every internal hit

resource_budget: At most 1,248 nominal search-seconds across 312 attempts; no parameter grid, no new representation, no solver mutation.

metric.primary: officially accepted TRUE hits by source family
metric.secondary: 5-second-only TRUE hits, FALSE candidates, replay failures, Lean rejections, proof nodes, certificate bytes

outcome_to_action.transfer_without_false_candidates: Retain cross-family capability evidence; next run the 5-second scheduling delta through the full 800 regression before any production change.
outcome_to_action.five_second_only_true_hits: Support a budget-margin change, still conditional on full regression and official marginal gains.
outcome_to_action.no_transfer: Do not promote from the two Order-5 cases; map selection/frontier differences before changing representation.
outcome_to_action.false_candidate_or_verifier_failure: Stop and classify as soundness, constructor-language, or boundary failure.
outcome_to_action.surprise: Preserve the unmatched outcome as a new residual rather than revising the hypothesis after inspection.
